newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet trade.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midsession on Wednesday in lethargic trade with prices being marked lower in line with the slide in Japanese prices, dealers said.
"It was again a very quiet morning session, very dull and boring. The prices were marked down after prices in Japan went down," a local rubber trader said.
Tokyo's benchmark July contract shed three yen to reach 158.7 yen in the morning session while Kobe's key July contract dropped 1.9 yen to 158.1 yen in the first afternoon session.
Traders said players will be waiting to see if the buying seen yesterday for RSS3 rubber will emerge anew in the afternoon.
"That is what we will be watching out for," a dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, April RSS3 was indicated at 121.50-123.50 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.50 cents.
April RSS1 was indicated at 172.00-174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21-$1.22) a kg from the previous 174.25 cents.
April TSR20 was indicated at 169.50 Singapore cents (US$1.19) a kg against 170.25 cents.
